json_desc_body: JSON Formatter is a lightweight, ultra-fast web utility designed to validate, format, and beautify raw JSON data. It takes messy, minified JSON code and transforms it into a clean, human-readable structure instantly.
json_question_1: Q1: Why should I use a JSON Formatter?
json_answer_1: Unformatted JSON is nearly impossible to read or debug. This tool adds proper indentation, line breaks, and spacing, making it easy for web developers to analyze API responses and configurations.
json_question_2: Q2: Is my JSON data safe and private?
json_answer_2: Absolutely. The formatting logic executes entirely inside your web browser using client-side JavaScript. Your data is never transmitted or uploaded to any external server.
base64_desc_body: This utility allows you to instantly encode plain text into Base64 format or decode Base64 strings back to human-readable text safely and locally.
base64_input_placeholder: Enter the code you want to encrypt or decrypt
base64-output-placeholder: Here is the text after processing
base64_question_1: Q1: What is the main purpose of Base64 encoding?
base64_answer_1: Base64 is widely used in web development to transmit binary data over text-based protocols, embed inline assets (like small images) directly into HTML/CSS, or safely obfuscate data tokens.
base64_question_2: Q2: Is it safe to decode sensitive config data here?
base64_answer_2: Yes, since all encoding and decoding functions run purely inside your browser's local engine, your tokens and sensitive configurations never leave your device.
hash_desc_body: Hash Generator is a local security utility that creates cryptographic signatures (hashes) using industry-standard algorithms like SHA-256 and MD5 instantly.
hash_input_placeholder: Enter the code you want to encrypt
hash_question_1: Q1: Can these generated hashes be cracked or reversed?
hash_answer_1: No, cryptographic hashes are designed as one-way mathematical functions. They are mathematically impossible to reverse, making them ideal for data integrity checks.
hash_question_2: Q2: How do developers use hashes in real projects?
hash_answer_2: Developers use them to verify file consistency, create unique keys, check data integrity, or compare digital signatures without exposing the original underlying raw text.

regex_question_1: Q1: How can I test and debug complex regular expression?
regex_answer_1: You can easily perform a regex debug by entering your pattern and test string into our interactive visualizer, The tool highlights matches in real-time making it simple to break down and fix errors in complex expressions.
regex_question_2: Q2: Is this tool a good alternative to Debuggex for regex testing?
regex_answer_2: Yes, this lightweight client-side regex tester serves as a fast and free alternative to classic debuggex regex platforms. It allows developers to evaluate expression instantly without any server-side delay and data or privacy risks.
regex_question_3: Q3: Where can I find a reliable regex debuggex utility online?
regex_answer_3: Our regex debuggex workspace provides an intuitive environment to decode and analyze expressions. Combined with our quick referance regular expression table, you everything you need to test patterns for Javascript, Python and more.
url_desc_body: This tool converts special characters in web links into a safe, percent-encoded format to comply with standard URI specs, or decodes them back for easy debugging.
url_input_placeholder: Enter the code you want to encrypt or decrypt
url_output_placeholder: Here is the text after processing
url_question_1: Q1: Why do web URLs need to be encoded?
url_answer_1: URLs can only contain specific safe characters. Query parameters that include symbols, non-ASCII characters, or spaces must be encoded to prevent broken links and routing errors.
url_question_2: Q2: What happens when I decode a URL?
url_answer_2: The tool takes characters like %20 or %2F and converts them back to plain spaces and slashes, allowing you to easily read complex tracking or API endpoints.
case_desc_body: This tool allows you to convert texts to a lot of scripts such as UpperCase, LowerCase, SentenceCase, CapitalizeCase, KebabCase, SnakeCase and CamelCase.
case_question_1: Q1: What is the main purpose of Case converter?
case_answer_1: The main objective is to quickly and safely change the status of the text to speed up the work of many users such as programmers, writers, content makers...
case_question_2: Q2: Is it safe to put sensitive data here?
case_answer_2: Yes, because all functions, processes and processing are carried out at the user's end, and no data is sent to any destination.
